title: Boulder Bear
shortDescription: Help a brave teddy dodge, jump, duck and ride everything rolling down a mountain.
description: Boulders, logs, wooden gates and giant boulders come rolling down three mountain trails toward a brave teddy bear. Change trails to dodge, jump boulders and logs, duck under gates, land on boulder trains and ride them, and climb from trains onto giants that block two or even all three trails. The pace climbs the longer you survive.
howToPlay: Change trails to get out of the way.
Jump over single boulders and rolling logs.
Duck to slip under wooden gates.
Land on top of a boulder train and ride it; only its front can knock you over.
Giant boulders need two jumps: land on a normal boulder train first, then jump again.
Survive as long as you can. Every boulder that rolls past earns bonus points.
